title: Run unpowered native suppliers at smaller ranks and give an explicit signed-multiplier clock
body:
The signed multiplier attains **κ = 0.003890115286594445**, matching the 430-factor [complete conditional proposal](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8044). Compared with that published machine, the last binary rank exponent falls **10.71 million-fold**, the numerical rank exponent **84.21-fold**, and the complete activation exponent **13.39 million-fold**. An explicit serial-tape clock covers every canonical input, including the range before full activation. [Construction and matched comparison](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/RESOLUTION.md) · [Exact ranks and integer ceilings](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/RESULT.json)

| Signed installation | Complete κ | Last binary H | Numerical H | log₂ S ≤ | Activation A | log₂ C ≤ |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Published 430-factor | .003890115286594445 | 1,024,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 | 1,600,000 | 1,048,576,000,000,000,000,000,000,003 | 1,365,004,016,064,257,029,713,503 | 22,364,160,000,000,000,000,160,001,642 |
| New seven-stage | .003890115286594445 | 95,600,000,000,000,000 | 19,000 | 513 | 101,973,332,976,357,367 | 1,670,731,087,109,379,198,659 |
| Prior compact | .00387992803556 | 1,600,000 | 610,000 | 1,638,400,002 | 2,471,428 | 30,535,241,478 |
| New compact | .00387992803556 | 144,000 | 8,500 | 513 | 161,992 | 2,510,262,059 |
| New at the selected rate | .00363005817 | 5,610 | 1,024 | 513 | 6,913 | 92,141,171 |

Each rank is $2^H$. The first sufficient significant input length is $2^{\lceil 2^A/6\rceil-1}+1$ bits. For $n\ge1$ the new total time is at most $2^{513}+2^E n(1+\log_2 n)^{1-\kappa}$, where $E$ is the last column. The prior recurring coefficients are new upper bounds on the same fixed-alphabet tape lowering. The predecessor reported an unspecified coefficient. The dominant new term in $E$ is $16384\sum_iH_i$. The highest-rate binary cohort still has $2^{8{,}795{,}200{,}000{,}000{,}000{,}000}$ real rows, and its first geometry has $2^{101{,}973{,}332{,}976{,}357{,}298}$ axes. These are sufficient bounds. Production payload execution and a measured crossover remain open. [Full clock and initial range](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/CLOCK.md) · [Tape movement and scalar costs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/ORDINARY-CLOCK.md) · [Activation and historical storage](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/ACTIVATION.md)

**Where the gain comes from.** A chronological scheduler lends real fields between compatible suspended raw calls and restores every owner. The direct binary receiver changes the supplied basis, spends one recursive interchange and restores it. The wide receiver performs one, three or five interchanges per genuine low/high packet, with a worst volume-weighted mean at most $7/3+16/[3(3^N-1)]$. Two 48-call Gaussian words at column scales one and eight supply all 105,216 independent outputs. The producer pays 564,144 cuts, whole-field shuttles, suspended stock, private grids and erasure. A seventh installed ordinary receiver changes the cold-start loss. Even six ideal, zero-debit stages at the actual retimed trial would miss the new κ. The tightened 70-bit stop also needs a sharper bound on the outer logarithms. [Chronological transfer](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/TRANSFER.md) · [Binary implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/five_exchange.py) · [Numerical execution](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/retimed_supplier.py) · [Precision](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/NUMERICAL.md) · [Outer clock](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/OUTER-CLOCK.md)

[Concurrent PR #8048](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8048) also analyzes a seventh retimed stage, using the earlier 31-cell Gaussian word and the 7/2-bit ordinary tariff. Its authors report a higher price candidate and leave its all-size inventory binding open. The comparison here uses the complete six-stage claim and the physical 54-cell construction in this PR. [Exact scope of the concurrent candidate](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9b4bb847d7573c8e08827fee22e9bcad8c9bb43c/research/p104-seven-stage-retimed/PROOF.md)

**How much survives retuning.** The old six-stage, 31-bit-debit tariff forces an activation exponent above $1.9293\cdot10^{20}$, more than **1,891 times** ours, even after retuning. If the powered tariff may add arbitrarily many stages, its floor remains **21.37 times** ours. A seven-stage powered sensitivity calculation gives 23.30 times ours. The new machine sits within 0.48% of its own activation floor even if its two tariffs can add unlimited stages. These restrictions apply to the stated raw trials, funding and stop rule. On fixed installation, the old published machine actually writes more than $2^{8{,}191{,}999{,}999{,}999{,}999{,}999{,}969{,}024}$ OPEN records. One cold CPython process generated the new eight fixed recipes in 81.68 seconds with 307,789,824 bytes peak RSS. [Exact refits and source probes](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/resolution.py) · [Old receipt](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c3746ea769fcf0d20818d7e18366f1b602e4aa3d/research/p104-six-stage-resolution/LAST-TICK-RECEIPT.json) · [Fixed installation and per-input tables](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/INSTALLATION.md)

**Reproduction.** From the repository root with Git and CPython 3.12, run

~~~sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/retimed-native-multiplier
python3.12 -IB research/retimed-native-multiplier/verify.py deep-receiver
~~~

Expected final lines

~~~text
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/retimed-native-multiplier outcome=completed
PASS_RETIMED_MULTIPLIER deep-receiver
~~~

The package replay passed locally. The separate full modulus-nine check evaluated all 2,834,352 physical records across 432 low/high configurations. The finite signed Fourier computation returned −345550037539 with coefficients 11811, 10996, 4152, 868 and 77, after 157,248 H dispatches and 138 shuttles. The profile reached the actual signed controller. Its finite 32-site H calls took the local kernel. Both real raw words, nonzero Gaussian states, the mandatory production-rank placement, and the full fixed installation have separate checks. The source-level inventory assigns 20 arena heads and 91 scratch slots per ordinary stage. Even eight separate sets for the seven receivers and the cold terminal fit the certified historical bound. The new replay tests 21 nested levels, dirty returns and sibling reuse. Fifteen Lean modules built and passed independent kernel replay. The axiom union is `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. Actual interpreter bindings, the complete sequential cost and the signed numerical recovery remain written proofs. All-column action, typed ownership and erasure, uniform compiler transfer, numerical precision and tape services, and analytic recovery remain inherited research premises. Independent scientific acceptance is open. [Verification and formal scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/VERIFICATION.md) · [Fixed tape-role assignment](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/STAGE-STORE.md) · [Historical-state Lean proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/lean/StageStore.lean) · [Stage obstruction and booking](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/lean/SevenStage.lean) · [70-bit stop clock](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/lean/OuterStop.lean) · [Fixed program lower bound](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd/research/retimed-native-multiplier/lean/CountedEpoch.lean)

Canonical base is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Ali Romman (@aliromman) supplied the paired circuits in [PR #8027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8027) and the physical model in [PR #8030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8030). @Clear1nsight supplied the tilted tariff in [PR #8033](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8033), the signed margin in [PR #8035](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8035) and the six-stage resolution in [PR #8044](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8044). The physical storage and routing predecessors include [PR #7914](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7914) and [PR #7981](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7981). [PR #8040](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8040) first removed the expanded powered installation. This contribution extends that work with unpowered suppliers and a separate full-cost proof. The historical replay prerequisite is credited to [PR #7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257). Ali Romman prepared this contribution with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The selected frontier remains on canonical main.
